subject:
EDIT IMAGE 1; do not redesign its art style. Image 1 is the only source and the exact art target, not a loose inspiration board. Make a neighbouring place in the SAME pixel-art game, a darker little riverside clearing called Moss Trail Lantern. Keep Image 1's high fixed camera, diagonal stepped banks, dark water occupying roughly one third of the frame (mainly foreground and right), broad connected shapes with similarly sized individual square pixels, sparse ground and large outlined 2D trees. Visually match its low-key exposure: mostly deep blue-green-black, with only one small lamp envelope and a small area of blue-green water light. Do not increase overall brightness or detail.

What to change: in the flat grassy opening on the left bank, keep one tall warm-yellow copper wayside lamp, a round deciduous tree and a few staggered pointed fir/cypress silhouettes. Replace the little foreground sprout with a waist-high moss-topped grey boundary stone; add one small blue-cloaked traveller beside the lamp, no larger than the lamp's pole height. Draw a short subtle earth footpath tapering into the dark left side, not a broad road. Use only those changes, keeping the restrained mood and fixed screen angle.

Render with the same readable hierarchy as the source: almost-flat muted olive ground in 2-3 fields of colour (no moss-grain carpet, no dense litter, no pebbles everywhere); broken navy-black silhouette edges on the trees, lamp and stone; 3-5 directional colour clusters over each leafy mass rather than detailed individual leaves; hard dark compact foot shadows on the grass. Match the original material-light contrast: light yellow-orange glass and the side of the nearest trunk and stone facing the lamp brighten; far sides remain dark. A local turquoise patch appears ONLY within the dark blue stream, with a narrow cold edge at the nearby stepped shoreline. Show actual recognizable vertically inverted silhouettes of the lamp and one tree on the water (anchored below the objects at the nearest bank), dark with one partial yellow reflection, softened or broken by 2 or 3 short ripples. You may soften the halos and underwater falloff on the SAME pixel grid, with the pixel contour of every object still sharp.

Do not turn it into painterly environment art, smooth vector art, tiled isometric blocks with tall walls, a realistic 3D scene, a carpet of intricate foliage, a black-and-white dither texture, teal bloom on the grass, depth-of-field blur, an overbright teal river, a second lamp or a second character. No horizon, sky, typesetting, border or UI. Output ONE single game-view frame, no sheet or comparison.
